The '''fleft-wauf''' were winged predators native to [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]], who hunted in packs. They were domesticated by the [[Wind Raiders/Legends|Wind Raiders]], who used them as war mounts. [[Stormwing]] was the personal fleft-wauf of [[Jeru]], a Wind Raider.
